selection_protocol: Refresh 40 On-policy candidates every 25 updates; retain their top four until the next refresh
primary_outcome: Mean binary reward at total step 275, averaged over 300 questions and eight responses per question
analysis: Report every seed, paired reward differences, their across-seed mean and sample standard deviation. Report new seeds separately before pooling with seeds 3 and 4. Do not select seeds by outcomes or tune the switching rule.
inputs: seed 3/4 selector-pair splits and their eight initial-policy cache rewards per candidate, imported by import_pair_inputs (5=3 6=4 7=3 8=4 9=3); no GPU cache generation
